title: MCUboot's encrypted serial-recovery path contains an attacker-controlled out-of-bounds stack write in…
description: MCUboot's encrypted serial-recovery path contains an out-of-bounds stack write vulnerability in the decrypt_region_inplace() function. This flaw arises from incorrect index calculation when decrypting uploaded encrypted images, allowing attacker-controlled data to overwrite adjacent stack memory before any signature authentication. The vulnerability requires a build with MCUBOOT_ENC_IMAGES and serial recovery enabled and access to the device's unauthenticated serial/USB recovery interface. It enables potential code execution in the secure bootloader root of trust and denial-of-service conditions. The issue affects versions before v2.0.0, with earlier versions having a similar out-of-bounds write in static memory. The CVSS score is 8.4 (high severity).
